name: @pipeworx/mcp-woocommerce

tools.name: woo_list_products
tools.description: List products from a WooCommerce store using Basic auth (consumer key + secret). Returns product IDs, names, prices, stock status, and type. Supports per_page (max 100) and page for pagination.

tools.name: woo_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single WooCommerce product by numeric ID. Returns full details including name, description, price, categories, attributes, and stock quantity.

tools.name: woo_list_orders
tools.description: List WooCommerce orders, optionally filtered by status (pending, processing, on-hold, completed, cancelled, refunded, failed). Returns order IDs, totals, customer info, and line items.

status.description: Filter by status: any, pending, processing, on-hold, completed, cancelled, refunded, failed

tools.name: woo_get_order
tools.description: Fetch a single WooCommerce order by numeric ID. Returns full order details including line items, customer billing/shipping, payment method, totals, and current status.

tools.name: woo_list_customers
tools.description: List customers registered in a WooCommerce store. Returns customer IDs, names, emails, and order counts. Supports per_page (max 100) and page for pagination.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-woocommerce forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the woocommerce pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
